fixes.target: table-2: Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in disrepair criterion

rows: Replace 10% or more or repair 30% or more
1 chimney need partial rebuilding or more

sentences: Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Wall structure is in poor condition when it needs: Replace 10% or more or repair 30% or more.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Wall finish is in poor condition when it needs: Replace/repoint/renew 50% or more.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Chimneys is in poor condition when it needs: 1 chimney need partial rebuilding or more.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Roof structure is in poor condition when it needs: Replace 10% or more or strengthen 30% or more.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Roof covering is in poor condition when it needs: Replace or isolated repairs to 50% or more.

Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Windows is in poor condition when it needs: Replace at least one window or repair/replace sash or member to least two (excluding easing sashes, reglazing painting).
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: External doors is in poor condition when it needs: Replace at least one.

Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Kitchen is in poor condition when it needs: Major repair or replace 3 or more items out of the 6 (cold water drinking supply, hot water, sink, cooking provision, cupboards, worktop).
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Bathroom is in poor condition when it needs: Major repairs or replace 2 or more items (bath, wash hand basin, WC).
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Electrical system is in poor condition when it needs: Replace or major repair to system.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Central heating boiler is in poor condition when it needs: Replace or major repair.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Central heating distribution is in poor condition when it needs: Replace or major repair.
Definition of ‘poor condition’ used in the disrepair criterion: Storage heaters is in poor condition when it needs: Replace or major repair.
